note: Each fixture is a hook event. Placeholders {HOME}, {PROJECT}, {STATE}, {ROOT} are expanded by the selftest: PROJECT is a temporary git repo that declares an evidence command, STATE is a temporary state directory, ROOT is the plugin root. 'source' says whether the command was run verbatim in a recorded session or constructed to represent a stated rule. 'trigger' on the first deny fixture is the substring whose removal must flip the decision: the proof that the test can fail. Add a fixture only when a real defect has occurred; a classifier tuned on invented examples finds invented examples.
